pages.raw_title: About Amneal | Our Purpose, Commitments and Capabilities
pages.raw_meta: Discover how Amneal is making medicines accessible for all. Learn about our founder-led commitment, diversified portfolio of high-quality complex generic, specialty and biosimilar medicines, and mission driven employees.
raw_blocks: We’re reimagining what’s possible to make medicine accessible for all

Amneal is a global biopharmaceutical company. For over two decades, we’ve helped people gain access to healthier lives by developing and delivering a diverse portfolio of generic and specialty pharmaceuticals.

“We witnessed firsthand the difficulty many patients face in affording their medicines. Believing there had to be a better way, we formed Amneal in 2002 to help ensure every person gets the medicine they need.”
Chirag & Chintu Patel Co-CEOs and Co-Founders of Amneal
The Patel family’s 20+ year commitment guiding Amneal’s contributions to patients and healthcare

Chirag and Chintu’s vision for founding Amneal was inspired by their father, Kanu Patel, an industrial pharmacist who worked as a pharmaceutical regulatory inspector in India. Raised on the Gandhian philosophy of truth and service, Kanu taught his sons to achieve prosperity through hard work and by conducting business with honesty and integrity.

The family immigrated to the United States in 1987, providing Chirag and Chintu with access to higher education and a business environment that fosters and rewards entrepreneurial spirit. Chirag began his business pursuits with several information technology start-ups while Chintu followed in his father’s footsteps as a pharmacist. During his time as a pharmacist, Chintu witnessed firsthand the struggle many patients had in choosing between buying food or their medication. The desire to provide affordable medicine to patients ignited a passion within Chintu, and with his father’s guidance and Chirag’s business savvy, Amneal was born.

Chirag and Chintu have grown the Amneal family, its portfolio of innovative and affordable medicines, and the company’s impact on the world. Family is not a buzz word here, but rather a through-line of our culture that unites, inspires, gives back and succeeds. Today, we’re pursuing a future for Amneal that is focused on what matters most: responsibly helping patients live better lives through high-quality, accessible medications.
United by a shared purpose and driven by commitments
We bring relentless determination to tackling the hard problems, so we can continuously expand access to high-quality medicines
We attack complexity to increase efficiency, making it easier to buy and administer our medicines
We amplify your impact, listening to and adapting to your needs, so we can support you for the long-term
We're a global biopharmaceutical company advancing medicine for all
After getting our start in generic medicine, we’ve since expanded to offer world-class scientific rigor, production capabilities, and commercial infrastructure.
We have developed our generic portfolio for 20+ years across a range of increasingly complex product formats.
We are building a leading U.S. position in biosimilars across oncology, movement disorders and beyond.
We’ve brought 40+ commercial injectables to U.S. hospitals and health systems, many of which are helping to address persistent drug shortages.
We have a growing portfolio of branded pharmaceuticals focused primarily on central nervous system and endocrine disorders.
When we can’t meet the need ourselves, we make sure to partner with other industry leaders to bring people the medicines they need when they need it.
Through our AvKARE segment, we distribute pharmaceuticals and other products for the U.S. federal government, retail, and institutional markets.
Amneal produces some of the most complex dosage forms in the industry, including
Going from solids and liquids products to tackling topical and transdermal products
Mission-driven work for healthier lives
At Amneal, innovation that boosts access and affordability of essential medicines fuels our purpose. Bring your conviction and grit and join us in transforming the future of healthcare. Careers
“Trust is a hallmark of our culture and my work with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs). Across the company, we recognize the magnitude of our work and that patients depend on us.”
Ghazal Banisadr, PhD Senior Director, Medical Affairs
“We make a real difference in the lives of others. I’m proud to contribute to the safety of our people and communities.”
Jonathan Robles Security Manager, Brookhaven, NY
“Personal development is rewarded here. 12+ years with Amneal has given me the skills and opportunities to grow from maintenance to my current role as a Quality Lab Assistant.”
Maria Delmis Burgos, Lab Assistant, Piscataway

pages.raw_title: Our U.S., Ireland and India Footprint | Amneal
pages.raw_meta: Amneal delivers high-quality, affordable medicines worldwide. Learn about our global operations and our commitment to a resilient pharmaceutical supply chain.
raw_blocks: Expanding access around the world

From Bridgewater to Mumbai, our global network connects research, manufacturing, and commercial offices across the U.S., Ireland, and India—empowering us to deliver high-quality medicines efficiently and responsibly, wherever patients need them most.
Powering U.S. industry, health, and security

We have one of the largest U.S.-based manufacturing footprints in the industry. We believe a more resilient pharmaceutical supply chain is essential to America’s health security—and we’re actively building it.
U.S. Home (Opens in a new window) U.S. Careers (Opens in a new window)
Supporting global infrastructure and innovation in India

Our state-of-the-art operations in India are an integral part of our global R&D and manufacturing network, supporting the commercialization of our products in the U.S. We also maintain active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) operations, enabling full vertical integration across a significant portion of our portfolio.
India Home (Opens in a new window) India Careers (Opens in a new window)
Manufacturing complex delivery formats in Ireland

Amneal Ireland Limited is focused on producing metered-dose and dry-powder inhalers. Ireland offers established infrastructure, highly skilled workforce, supportive government, and a strong business environment that drives innovation—and Amneal is proud to build on that foundation.
